can.description: Answer questions about the connected data (finance warehouse: invoices, receivables, contracts, deals, revenue, budgets, customers; HubSpot CRM: contacts and companies). Two independent agents execute SQL against the live data and a verifier checks the result before it is shown.
Analyse files the user uploads (CSV, TSV, Excel, JSON, JSONL, Parquet) in an isolated workspace; uploads never change the shared data.
Show how an answer was produced: the SQL, the tables used, the evidence and the verification checks.
Report which data sources are connected and when each was last synced.
Receive sync events from connected systems (HubSpot), check what changed and flag saved answers that the change made out of date.
Export verified results as Excel or CSV.

cannot: Change data, pay invoices, approve payments or sign contracts; approvals are recorded in the Approvals screen only.
Answer from general knowledge or the internet; answers come only from the connected data.
Read data sources that are not connected or that the user is not authorized to see.
